property_summary: After a successful Collect call by any actor, the reference contract always resets its reentrancy lock allowing a subsequent Collect by the same actor (or any actor) to proceed normally (i.e. not permanently blocked), whereas the mutant that omits resetting locked_ can leave the contract permanently locked so a later Collect call will be blocked (revert); the test fuzzes actor and amounts to find such a case.
change_summary: Change the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit re-locking after the function body (remove resetting locked_ to false), so locked_ remains true and later calls can be blocked, affecting Collect behavior across calls.
